main_measure.name: OLS slope of 10-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; slope < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: share of positive excess returns, forecast>0 minus forecast=0

decided_by: Inconclusive rule met: the slope's t lies between -2 and 2 (or could not be computed).
reading: The window's mean 10-bar return (holding drift) is the mean of the forward 10-bar return over all bars of that window that have one, samples are taken at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with the full 10 bars inside the window, and the slope's t is the ordinary OLS t (slope / standard error).
